item: Row 367: the app chrome follows a language switch
key_paths: src/static/app-core.js; src/static/app-boot.js; configs/i18n_frozen_renderers.txt; tests/core_live_node_test.js; tests/test_core_live.py; tests/rewalk_b27_node_test.js; tests/test_crash_screen_honesty.py
summary: Eleven app-core.js renderers leave the frozen list. The health pill (word and hover), the crash screen (drawn once, its words held, the retry button keeps its listener), the airplane pop-up's OK, the network consent popup's lane list (from the settings it was drawn from) and interfaces line, the guided setup's interfaces line, the AI install question's default reason and the Coverage loading line are held; the task manager's Active, Queue, Schedule and Coverage panels are drawn again from what they last read by repaintTaskManager (never a fetch, nothing for a panel never drawn, nothing over a Coverage read in flight). No new strings.
